senses.def: the hard durable wood of any oak; used especially for furniture and flooring
a deciduous tree of the genus Quercus; has acorns and lobed leaves
ex: great oaks grow from little acorns

senses.def: an implement used to propel or steer a boat
a fertile tract in a desert (where the water table approaches the surface)
a shelter serving as a place of safety or sanctuary
annual grass of Europe and North Africa; grains used as food and fodder (referred to primarily in the plural: ‘oats’)
seed of the annual grass Avena sativa (spoken of primarily in the plural as ‘oats’)
a commitment to tell the truth (especially in a court of law); to lie under oath is to become subject to prosecution for perjury
a solemn promise, usually invoking a divine witness, regarding your future acts or behavior
ex: they took an oath of allegiance

senses.def: meal made from rolled or ground oats
